_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 18 — arm 12 (single-layer canonical) + BOTH level cards:
network.iono_seed_field_frame (LV-1) and network.rx_cb_carry_demean (LV-2).
The combined posture the spec nominates as the candidate to re-open the 305-station
gate (docs/SPEC_level_information_budget.md S4).
WHY BOTH TOGETHER IS NOT REDUNDANT.  They act on the SAME defective screen from
opposite sides.  The rx-CB inject gate tests the PREFIT quantity
|value_abs - x_lin(cb)| = |x_r,prev| against 10 sigma + 0.5 m -- and x_lin(cb) is a
FROZEN first-epoch seed, so a station whose true DCB sits far from that seed is
withheld EVERY epoch for the whole run, which no amount of receiver health explains.
- LV-1 fixes the frame: seeding the iono in the field's frame lets
initializeCodeBiases book the receiver's GF lump into the DCB where it belongs, so
x_lin(cb) starts near truth and the prefit innovation is small.
- LV-2 fixes the statistic: the gate (and the fold) judge |innov - mu|, so a
COHERENT move of the whole set is no longer read as 61 simultaneous receiver
resets.
Either alone should cut the ~58 % skip rate; the two together should very nearly
eliminate it, and that decomposition is what this arm measures against arms 15 and 17.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- Skip rate lowest of the four arms (12 / 15 / 17 / 18); fold count highest.
- a00 trajectory: same family as arm 12 (ignition ~24.7, ignition trough, upward
inflection by ~ep 16, gate 0/0/0, in-band 20/20).  LV-1 cannot move the level
directly (linearization invariance) and LV-2 targets the breathing, which 20
epochs cannot resolve -- so a LARGE a00 change here is a warning, not a win: it
would mean the extra folds LV-1+LV-2 admit are stiffening the level crutch rather
than replacing it, exactly the over-retention signature the lane A/B taught us to
read (quieter priors, louder data residuals).  Check the postfit sigma0 families
before celebrating any level improvement.
- Both run-end lines non-zero: LV-1 `reframed` ~ the LOS count, LV-2 `mu computed on
N epochs` with 0 freezes.
Only promote to the 1 h arm (_ext63_gps_dual_1h_lv12.json) if this smoke matches.
